title: "Development"

## Tests

The tests use Pest and run under PHP 8.3, 8.4, and 8.5. They call functions through
`pipe()`, so they parse on every version. `tests/Pipe/` holds the tests written
with `|>`; `bin/test` leaves them out before PHP 8.5.

```bash
composer install
bin/test                 # loads .ext/libphit.dylib when present
NO_EXT=1 bin/test        # pure-PHP descriptive statistics
PHP=/path/to/php83 bin/test
```

The method chain's `@method` list in `src/Chain.php` and the API reference
are generated from the source. After adding or changing a function, run
`bin/chain-docblock` and `bin/api-reference`; a test fails while either is
out of date. `bin/api-reference` writes one entry per public function and
expression method, from its signature and docblock, into
`docs/reference/_api/`, and the index `docs/reference/index.qmd`. Each
function must be listed in a section of its `$sections` map.

Most tests compare phplyr with R. The scripts in `tests/r/` run the same
pipelines with dplyr and tidyr and write JSON fixtures to `tests/Fixtures/`:

```bash
Rscript tests/r/reference.R   # single-table functions, windows, across, tidyselect
Rscript tests/r/expr.R        # expressions
Rscript tests/r/joins.R       # joins and rowwise
Rscript tests/r/join_by.R     # join_by() conditions
Rscript tests/r/tidyr.R       # tidyr functions
Rscript tests/r/rows.R        # set operations, rows_*(), dplyr 1.2 helpers
Rscript tests/r/coverage.R    # functions added after phplyr 0.1.0
Rscript tests/r/models.R      # lm() and glm() coefficients
Rscript tests/r/janitor.R     # janitor functions (needs the janitor package)
```

`tests/PolarsTest.php` runs about 120 pipelines on both `DataFrame` and
`PolarsTable` and requires the same columns, types, groups, and rows from
each. The `polars` CI job runs it with the prebuilt php_polars extension.

`Phibble\Expr\Clock::freeze()` fixes the time that `today()` and `now()`
return, for tests.

`composer lint` checks the naming conventions with PHP_CodeSniffer.

## Documentation

The site is a Quarto project in `docs/`. Code examples live in
`docs/examples/*.php`. `bin/docs-examples` runs each one with `docs/` as the
working directory and writes `docs/examples/_<name>.md` with the code and its
output, which the pages include. Rendering never executes PHP.

An example uses `|>`, and `docs/examples/<name>.chain.php` beside it is the
same example as a method chain. `bin/docs-examples` runs both and fails if
their output differs. The page shows the two in tabs labeled "PHP 8.5+" and
"PHP 8.3–8.4", with the output once. `bin/docs-examples` needs PHP 8.5, and it
loads phit from `.ext/libphit.dylib` for the model examples.

Most examples leave out the `require` line and the imports, and
`bin/docs-examples` adds them before it runs the code, with `$data` set to the
[PHPstats datasets](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets) folder. Examples
read their data from there by URL, so they need network access. An example that
requires `vendor/autoload.php` itself is a complete script. It runs as
written, so a missing import fails the run, and the page shows it without the
opening tag and the `require` line. The first example, the R translation script,
and the pages in the Examples section (`docs/examples/<slug>.qmd`, with their
code in `docs/examples/pages/`) are complete scripts. A subdirectory's
`_prelude.php`, such as the Gallery's, replaces the generated prelude for its
examples, and the page shows it once.

```bash
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/docs-examples   # refresh example output
PHP=/path/to/php85 bin/render-docs     # examples, quarto render, publish to docs/
```

The first example reads `penguins` by URL from the datasets repository's
`main` branch, and a test checks that the README and site.json do the same.

Commit the rendered HTML. The PHPstats site imports it from the commit it pins
and serves it at <https://phplyr.phpstats.org/docs>. GitHub Pages serves
redirects to those pages, which `.github/workflows/pages.yml` builds with
`bin/pages-redirects`.

## Site content

`site/` holds phplyr's content for `phplyr.phpstats.org`. The PHPstats site
reads it at a pinned commit.

| Path | Contents | Made by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `site/site.json` | Manifest: summary, install, example, docs pages, examples, and file lists | `bin/site-manifest` |
| `site/benchmarks/*.json` | The Benchmarks pages: phibble's workloads, the backend pipelines with dplyr, and the models | `bin/site-benchmarks`, from `docs/benchmarks/` |
| `site/verifications/*.json` | The Verification pages: every test that checks phplyr against R or against DataFrame, with its status, assertion count, and largest floating-point errors | `bin/site-verifications` |

The records follow the PHPstats site's evidence record format, and
`tests/SiteTest.php` checks their shape.

`bin/site-verifications` runs the test suite with `PHPLYR_VERIFY_LOG` set.
Every test then logs its status, the fixtures it read through `rReference()`,
its assertions, and the differences recorded by `expectClose()`. A test that
can be skipped before it reads its fixture names its record with
`->group('verify:<record>')`. Failed and skipped tests are written with their
reason, and the script exits with an error after writing when a test failed.
Set `PHIT_EXTENSION` to the phit extension to load, and `POLARS_PHP` to a PHP
command that loads php_polars to write the PolarsTable parity file.

The R scripts in `tests/r/` write the fixtures and record the R and package
versions in `tests/Fixtures/r-versions.json`. Run them from the repository
root, for example `Rscript tests/r/reference.R`.

Published benchmark records come from the Linux benchmark machine. The
scripts in `bench/` write them to `docs/benchmarks/`: `harness-<backend>.json`,
`backends-results.json`, `dplyr-results.json` (run `bench/backends.php
--csv-dir=bench/data` first), and `models-results.json`. Then
`bin/site-benchmarks` writes `site/benchmarks/`.

## Layout

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `src/functions/verbs.php` | Single-table functions |
| `src/functions/chain.php`, `src/Chain.php` | `phplyr()` method chains and `pipe()` |
| `src/functions/vectors.php` | Summary, window, and conditional helpers |
| `src/functions/select.php` | tidyselect helpers and `across()` |
| `src/functions/joins.php`, `rows.php` | Joins, set operations, and `rows_*()` |
| `src/functions/groups.php` | Group utilities, binding, and model adapters |
| `src/functions/tidyr.php` | tidyr functions |
| `src/Vec.php` | The per-group vector expression behind the helpers |
| `src/Ops.php` | Group-vector primitives over the Table contract |
